title: Localisation at a good radius: integer multiplicity truncations with uniformly bounded mass and boundary mass (Simon 7.2 proof; computation 4.9–4.11)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let T_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ; GeometricCurrentOn univ n) be integer multiplicity currents (IsIntegerMultiplicity) such that sup_j (M_V(T_j) + M_V(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every bounded open V ⊆ ℝ^P, and let W ⊆ ℝ^P be bounded. Then there are a compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ, Λ ∈ [0, ∞) (NNReal) and integer multiplicity currents T'_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ) such that for every j: spt T'_j ⊆ K, M(T'_j) ≤ Λ, M(∂T'_j) ≤ Λ, and T'_j(ω) = T_{φ(j)}(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. Here M_V = massOn V (SimonGMT mass with the Euclidean coefficient norm), M = mass = M_{ℝ^P} and spt = GeometricCurrentOn.support.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (W : Set (Euclid P)), Bornology.IsBounded W → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V → Bornology.IsBounded V → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn V + (Ts j).boundary.massOn V) < ∞) → ∃ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (Ts' : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact K ∧ StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts' j)) ∧ (∀ j, (Ts' j).support ⊆ K) ∧ (∀ j, (Ts' j).mass ≤ Λ ∧ (Ts' j).boundary.mass ≤ Λ) ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ W → Ts' j ω = Ts (φ j) ω
